A.name: 工坊初启
A.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: polished square Steam Workshop cover candidate, 1:1, preferably 1536x1536. Generate an original new illustration using the three local images as references only.
Reference roles: image 1 strictly fixes the same adult dragon-woman character identity, face, proportions and species; image 2 fixes the approved SuQing series anime pixel-illustration treatment and embroidered title plaque; image 3 fixes the PORTAL DEVICE SHAPE (ignore all words and labels on that sheet).
Identity invariants: silver-white long hair, pale violet eyes, paired ivory dragon horns, pale lavender dragon wings, one long white-scaled tail, white floral hair ornament and ribbons. Same recognizable face as reference 1. Fully clothed in tasteful white/lavender practical survivor clothing with modest silver embroidery; suitable for working and traveling. Keep horns, wing(s), and tail visibly identifiable. She is the only person.
Device invariants: a tall narrow human-sized upright inverted-U rounded-top doorway, straight white/silver uprights, lavender inner trim, small control/status screen on RIGHT upright, low plinth with EXACTLY FOUR distinct car-battery bays in one row. At least one bay visibly empty and the others installed so the battery mechanic reads. Match image 3 proportions; NEVER turn it into a wide circular Stargate, massive vehicle gate, or freestanding magical ring. Subtle violet energy within the opening is illustrative. Entire base and all four bays must be visible above the title plaque.
Style: fine crisp deliberate anime pixel illustration, rich environmental storytelling and clearly resolved pixels, soft dramatic lighting, white/lavender/dark-purple series palette, warm brass frame accents, same family as image 2. Not 3D, not photoreal, not blurry, no low-detail sketch. Main girl and portal recognizable at 256px thumbnail.
Typography/layout invariant: bottom 25-28 percent contains a beautiful embroidered dark-purple rectangular title plaque with fine brass/silver corner hardware, lavender botanical stitches, restrained ornament, identical series hierarchy. Exact Chinese title on two lines: first line "蘇清的", second larger line "传送门". Small neat English subtitle exactly "SuQing's Portals". No other text. No game/Build/mod version numbers, no logo, no watermark. No vehicles, no extra people, no fairy, no extra limbs. Keep important content inside the square with breathing room.

Scene A, warm workshop commissioning: composition character on the LEFT in a three-quarter standing view, looking back at the viewer, one hand operating the small panel while the other rests naturally at her side. Tall portal on the RIGHT. Cozy repaired brick-and-wood survivor workshop, hanging amber worklamp, workbench with one premium camera and one handheld walkie-talkie as crafting clues. Door opening shows a distinctly different distant greenhouse homestead under purple evening sky. Warm amber interior versus violet gate light. Intimate, handcrafted and welcoming; no giant control console covering the base.

icon.name: 独立四槽拱门icon
icon.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone square game MOD ICON, genuinely transparent background. Use the supplied model sheet solely to match the current physical device: tall narrow human-sized inverted-U doorway with straight white-silver posts and a rounded top, purple inner trim, tiny right-post status screen, low dark-violet base with EXACTLY FOUR well-separated car-battery bays, three installed purple-top batteries and one clearly empty dark bay. Not a wide round Stargate. One object, strong chunky near-front three-quarter silhouette centered with generous transparent padding. Polished high-quality anime pixel icon with crisp intentional pixels and a soft restrained lavender portal glow contained inside the arch; thick readable contour and very simple shapes for 32/64px use. Keep four bays discernible as four simple blocks. No character, scenery, ground plane, detached shadow, arrows, text, letters, digits, labels, logo, watermark or frame. A dedicated icon design, not a cropped miniature cover. Preserve actual alpha transparency.
